content.question: When is t-SNE typically preferred over PCA?
options: For feature engineering and data preprocessing of large datasets.
When the model needs features that capture maximum variance.
When computational efficiency is the top priority.
For exploratory data analysis and visualizing high-dimensional clusters or manifolds in a low-dimensional space.
content.answer: For exploratory data analysis and visualizing high-dimensional clusters or manifolds in a low-dimensional space.
